dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Hah, all eyes are on me! Lowly servants, behold the Almighty Dragonlord's magnificence!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Yeah, a loud, glowing bug... Not something you see every day.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Kiniiiiiich! I dare you to say that again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I have some errands to run, so I should get going.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Yeah, work yourself to the bone, smart guy...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Well, that was a lucky win. Want to play another round?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Gah, you're so boring! You won, and you're not even gonna gloat?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: You're hopeless! The Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw's wisdom is wasted on you!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: No one asked for your "wisdom."

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Sure thing. I've played a few rounds of this game before.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: And you only won because of me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Victory! All thanks to the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw! Muahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Keep on telling yourself that.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Well, I lost.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Yeah! YOU lost! Y'know why? Because you didn't listen to ME!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Remember, lowly servant — you can't lose with the Almighty Dragonlord by your side!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Hmm, that doesn't seem like a fair game. I think you should leave, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's play Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: You seemed distracted. Was Ajaw being too loud? Let's go another round, just the two of us.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: I was giving you advice, you heartless ingrate!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Looks like your stupidity knows no bounds, Kinich! You actually lost with a hand like that? Hah, I don't even know what to say.

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Either step up or shut up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
